budget_source.description:
BudgetSource tells the portal where the budget came from: "team"
when the App's team hands out budgets from a pool, else empty.

mcp_server_ids.description:
MCPServerIDs / MCPServers mirror the list endpoint (serializeApp):
the portal app page mounts its "MCP access" section from them.

model_router_ids.description:
Model Routers the app is granted (Enterprise); the portal app page
shows their unified-ingress model strings.

semantic_router_ids.description: Semantic Routers the app is granted (Enterprise).

is_active.description:
IsActive is the live switch. Omitted = unchanged on update, live
on create (unless the caller lacks apps:publish, in which case
the app is created inactive). Setting it needs apps:publish.

mcp_server_ids.description:
MCPServerIDs binds Tyk-managed MCP servers (Enterprise). Omitted
leaves the bindings unchanged on update; an empty list clears them.

model_router_ids.description:
ModelRouterIDs grants Model Routers (Enterprise). Omitted leaves
the grants unchanged on update; an empty list clears them.

semantic_router_ids.description:
SemanticRouterIDs grants Semantic Routers (Enterprise), with
the same omitted/empty rules.

team_id.description:
TeamID attributes the App to a team (Enterprise team budgets).
Omitted = the owner's budget team on create, unchanged on update.

credential_active.description:
CredentialActive is the state of the app's credential, null when the
app has none, so the apps list can show it without a credentials fetch.

mcp_server_ids.description: Tyk-managed MCP servers bound to the app (Enterprise).

model_router_ids.description: Model Routers the app is granted (Enterprise).

semantic_router_ids.description: Semantic Routers the app is granted (Enterprise).

spend_tracked.description:
SpendTracked is false in Community Edition, where spending is not
recorded and current_spend is always zero.

api.BulkActionResult.description: One object's outcome in a bulk action

access_granted_via_app.description:
AccessGrantedViaApp says whether building an App is how a developer
gets to use this item. Always true for LLM providers, data sources and
tools; for plugin resources it is the type's resolved value with any
per-instance override applied. When false the portal shows no
"Build app" action.

PortalDetailURL is the providing plugin's own page for the item, set
whenever the type declared portal_detail_path. When access is not
granted through an App it replaces the built-in detail page as the
item's detail view; otherwise it is a secondary link next to
"Build app".

auth_mode.description:
MCP servers (Tyk-managed): how a client reaches the proxy and what it
offers. Brokerable says whether an App credential can be minted for it.

kind.description:
Kind is the type-specific sub-classification: the vendor code of an LLM
provider, the store type of a data source, the protocol of a tool and
"<plugin id>:<slug>" for a plugin resource. KindLabel is set when the
backend knows a display name (plugin resource types); the UI maps the
built-in codes itself.

models.description:
Detail responses only: the known models and the provider's metadata
(secrets redacted, as on the admin API).

operations.description:
Tools. A tool is served by the AI Studio gateway; the access methods say
how an App may reach it, and each URL is present only when its method is
switched on. A tool with neither method on is chat only and is not in
the catalog at all.

router_routes.description:
RouterRoutes are a Semantic Router's routes (name and description; the
examples and keywords that pick them are configuration and stay out).

router_slug.description:
Model Routers: the slug, the "{slug}/{model}" strings a client sends
to the unified ingress, and (detail only) the LLMs it can route to.

access_granted_via_app.description:
AccessGrantedViaApp is the type-level answer to "does an App credential
grant access to these?"; the item carries the per-instance value.

api.ChatHistoryRecordListResponse.description: Chat History Record list response model

mcp_server_ids.description: MCPServerIDs binds Tyk-managed MCP servers the user's teams can see.

model_router_ids.description:
ModelRouterIDs grants Model Routers published in the user's LLM
catalogues (Enterprise).

semantic_router_ids.description:
SemanticRouterIDs grants Semantic Routers published in the user's LLM
catalogues (Enterprise).

embedder_id.description:
EmbedderID links an embedder and takes precedence over the
embed_* fields (0 unlinks). Without it, the embed_* fields are
resolved to a matching embedder.

owner_label.description:
OwnerLabel is the replica's label (cluster.NodeOptions.Label), empty
when it has none or is no longer registered.

owner_live.description: OwnerLive: the replica's registration is fresh.

sync_status.description: Sync status fields for configuration sync tracking

api_key.description: APIKey: "[redacted]" on update keeps the stored key.

plugin_ids.description: PluginIDs in execution order; empty detaches every auth plugin.

config.description:
Config is the guardrail configuration (provider, detectors,
action, ...) for a guardrail filter.

filter_id.description:
FilterID names the saved filter this test belongs to. A guardrail config
whose connection holds $SECRET/ or $ENV/ references is only run when
its connection block matches that saved filter's, so the test endpoint
cannot be used to send a resolved secret to a caller-chosen endpoint.

failover.description:
Failover waterfall. On PATCH an absent key keeps the stored
value and an explicit null clears it.

governed_metadata.description:
Governed metadata (Enterprise): admin responses carry the raw values map and a
status; portal responses carry a display-ready [{key,label,type,value}] list.

api.LoginPageProfileResponse.description: Sanitized login page SSO profile model

active.description:
Active is the live switch. Omitted = inactive on create (the
model default), unchanged on update. Setting it needs
model-routers:publish.

short_description.description: Portal presentation (the router is published in LLM catalogues).

operation.description: Operation is the bare-form alternative to the data envelope above.

version.description:
Version changes whenever a plugin registers or removes permission
resources, so clients can tell a cached catalogue is stale.

updates_available.description: UpdatesAvailable counts installed plugins (across all pages) with a newer marketplace version.

permission_key.description:
PermissionKey is the RBAC resource that stands for this plugin
("plugin:<manifest id>"); omitted for plugins with no admin surface.
Top level rather than inside Attributes so the many hand-written
Attributes literals in this package stay untouched.

version.description: Version and Marketplace are top level for the same reason.

api.PreferencesResponse.description: Notification preferences of the signed-in user

email_notifications_enabled.description:
EmailNotificationsEnabled controls whether notifications are also
emailed; the bell receives them either way.

notifications_enabled.description:
NotificationsEnabled is the in-app admin fan-out consent (new users,
app requests). It can only be on for administrators.

new_user_show_portal.description:
Provisioning defaults for users this profile creates. Pointers so
that an omitted field means "show" rather than "hide".

orphaned_permissions.description:
OrphanedPermissions are held permissions whose resource is not in the
catalogue right now: grants on a plugin that is uninstalled or not
loaded. They stay on the role and take effect again when the plugin
returns; the role editor lists them separately.

source.description:
Source is "host" for a binding the host application manages
(read-only here), empty otherwise.

has_value.description:
HasValue says whether the secret holds a non-empty value without
exposing it, so the list can flag a placeholder that was never
filled in.

referenced_by.description:
ReferencedBy lists the objects that read this secret through a
$SECRET/<name> reference. Always present, empty when nothing does.

active.description:
Active is the live switch. Omitted = inactive on create, unchanged on
update. Setting it needs semantic-routers:publish.

embedder_id.description:
EmbedderID is the embedder of the embedding stage (0 or omitted: none).
A settings.embedding naming an LLM ({llm_id, model}) is still accepted
and saved as the embedder linked to that LLM with that model.

short_description.description: Portal presentation (the router is published in LLM catalogues).

router.description: Router is the draft to test (POST /semantic-routers/test only).

apis_read.description:
APIsRead is the probed state of the apis_read capability
(ok | denied | unverified | no), empty when never probed.

active.description:
Active is the live switch. Omitted = unchanged on update, live on
create (unless the caller lacks tools:publish, in which case the
tool is created inactive). Setting it needs tools:publish.

oas_spec.description:
OASSpec must be the base64 encoding of the UTF-8 OpenAPI
document. Raw JSON or YAML is rejected with a 400.

rest_access_enabled.description:
Access methods. Omitted = unchanged on update; on create a new
tool is chat only (both off). Not accepted on client tools.

Access methods. Chat is always available and is not listed.
AppGrantable is false for a chat-only tool, which cannot be bound to an
App.

rest_endpoint_url.description:
Gateway URLs of the two access methods, built from TOOL_DISPLAY_URL (or
PROXY_URL) and the slug. Empty for client tools and when no base URL is
configured. They say where a method is served, not whether it is on.

slug.description:
Slug is the path segment the gateway serves the tool under. It is
computed server-side (with transliteration), so clients must not derive
it from the name.

budget_team_id.description:
BudgetTeamID is the team the user's new Apps and chat spend are
attributed to (Enterprise team budgets); null = resolved automatically.

disabled.description: Account switch. A disabled user cannot authenticate by any means.

is_admin.description: omitted means unchanged; roles are the source of truth in Enterprise

account_type.description:
Profile fields for the signed-in user's own menu. AccountType is
the legacy role label the users list shows as "role"; the key
itself is never included here (see POST /common/me/api-key/roll).

has_admin_access.description:
HasAdminAccess is true when the user holds at least one permission
and may therefore open the administration surface.

permissions.description: Permissions is the effective permission set; ["*"] for full admins.

rbac_enabled.description: RBACEnabled reports whether fine-grained roles are active.

roles.description: Roles lists the roles behind the permissions (Enterprise only).

sso_api_keys_allowed.description:
SSOAPIKeysAllowed is whether this user may hold an API key under
the ALLOW_SSO_USER_API_KEYS policy (always true for non-SSO users).

actions.description: Actions lists the actions this resource offers, in display order.

description.description: Description is optional help text for the role editor.

dynamic.description:
Dynamic marks a resource registered at runtime (plugins) rather than
in init(); dynamic resources can be replaced and unregistered.

group.description: Group is the navigation group the resource belongs to; see Groups.

key.description:
Key is the permission resource slug: plural, kebab-case, matching the
route collection segment ("llms", "data-catalogues").

label.description: Label is the human name, matching the admin navigation where one exists.

plugin.description:
Plugin is the permission key of the plugin that contributed this
resource ("plugin:<manifest id>"), or "" for built-in resources. The
role editor groups plugin resources under their plugin.

plugin_label.description: PluginLabel is the display name of the contributing plugin.

privileged.description:
Privileged marks resources whose write/delete can escalate access
(users, groups, roles, identity providers, plugins). The UI warns.

sensitive.description:
Sensitive marks a data class (transcripts, logs, secrets) that is split
out so read can be withheld independently. The UI shows a shield.

compliance_events_warning.description:
Script-emitted compliance events (e.g. PII redacted, content rewritten).
Distinct from PolicyViolations, which only counts request-blocking 4xx responses.

total_blocks.description: TotalBlocks counts requests that were actually blocked (4xx in proxy_logs).

total_flagged.description:
TotalFlagged counts script-emitted compliance events (warning + critical)
where the request was allowed through but the filter raised a concern
(e.g. PII redaction, content rewrite).

hook_type.description: Optional - will be populated from manifest

detail_path.description:
DetailPath is where the object can be opened when the UI has no route
of its own for it: plugin resource instances resolve their resource
type's PortalDetailPath template here. Empty for built-in objects.

vocabularies.description:
Vocabularies holds the terms of every vocabulary referenced by Fields,
keyed by slug, so a consumer can render selects with labels without a
second round-trip (plugins only see this via the management API).

example.description: Example is placeholder text for the UI.

secret.description:
Secret marks a field that holds a credential. The UI offers the secret
picker and the value is expected to be a $SECRET/ or $ENV/ reference.

has_threshold.description:
HasThreshold reports whether DetectorConfig.Threshold applies, and
ThresholdHint what it means ("0..1 score", "0..6 severity").

available.description:
Available reports whether an implementation is registered in this
build. False in the Community Edition.

detectors.description:
Detectors is the fixed catalogue. When OpenDetectors is true the
provider also accepts names outside it (the generic HTTP provider,
whose server defines its own).

docs_url.description: DocsURL points at the provider's page in the documentation.

local.description: Local reports an in-process provider (no network call).

redacts.description: Redacts reports whether ActionRedact is available.

require_any_connection.description:
RequireAnyConnection demands at least one connection field even though
none is individually required (Lakera: an API key for the SaaS or an
endpoint for a self-hosted Guard).

auth_method.description:
AuthMethod is how the actor authenticated: "session" (browser
cookie) or "api_key" (user API key); empty for unauthenticated
requests such as failed logins.

diff.description:
Diff of changed fields for updates, and the final state for deletes.
Shape: {"field": {"old": <v>, "new": <v>}}. Sensitive columns are
redacted before storage.

request_dump.description: Populated only when detailed recording is enabled.

total_cost.description: cost for the specified date range

total_tokens.description: total tokens for the specified date range

user_email.description: Email of the user who owns the app (pointer to handle null case)

user_id.description: ID of the user who owns the app

header_name.description: Header, Query or Cookie name the token scheme reads (auth_token, basic, jwt).

prm.description: PRM is the OAuth 2.1 protected resource metadata when advertised.

schemes.description: Schemes lists every enabled scheme name with its resolved type.

auth.description: Auth records per-primitive overrides from the definition.

source.description: Source names the REST operation behind a REST-to-MCP tool.

url.description: URL is the absolute metadata URL when the endpoint URL is known.

required_on_publish.description:
RequiredOnPublish makes the field mandatory only when the object goes
live (activate / enable): a submitter can save a draft without it, but
the publish is refused until it is filled. Independent of Required.

warn_if_past.description: date fields: warn when the value is in the past

deleted.description:
Deleted marks a team deleted since it spent: its name may since have
been reused, and it has no page to link to.

rendered_payload.description:
RenderedPayload is produced once on the first attempt and reused by
every retry so receivers see byte-identical bodies.

target_url.description:
TargetURLSnapshot is the URL at enqueue time, kept so the log stays
meaningful after the target is edited or deleted.

synthetic.description: Synthetic marks events created by "send test", not received from the bus.

description.description:
Description says what belongs on this route. The judge reads it, and
the portal shows it.

keywords.description: Keywords decide the route outright when one matches.

name.description:
Name is the route's identifier ("complex", "code"): what the judge
answers with and what "{router}/{route}" names.

priority.description: Priority breaks ties between routes (higher first).

threshold.description:
Threshold is the similarity (0..1] the best example must reach for the
route to be picked by the embedding stage. 0 means DefaultThreshold.

utterances.description:
Utterances are example requests. The input is compared with each and
the route scores its best match (cosine similarity).

embedders.description: Embedders linked to the object (an LLM).

semantic_routers.description: SemanticRouters that route to, hand off to, or classify with the object.

name.description: display name at the time of the query

type.description: llm, app, filter, tool, datasource, plugin, model_router, semantic_router, model_price, oauth_client, access_token

since.description:
Since is the reference point: the namespace's last push, or -- when
no push was ever recorded but an edge is in sync with the namespace
checksum -- that edge's ack. Nil when there is neither, in which case
every object is "created". Baseline says which.

same_version.description: already on the target; nothing to apply

allow_downgrade.description: required to move to an older version

approved_scopes.description: must cover every scope the target adds

profileID.description:
ProfileID is the identity provider profile that produced this login,
taken from ProfileIDHeader; empty when the broker did not identify one.

blocked.description: Blocked is a live App with a budget of zero.

deleted.description:
Deleted Apps keep their spend in the period they made it, but no
longer hold an allocation.

uncapped.description:
Uncapped is a live App with no limit of its own; its spend counts
towards the team ceiling but it holds no allocation.

blocking.description: Blocking: the team hard-blocks and its Apps are being refused.

over_budget.description:
OverBudget: spend has reached the budget. OverAllocated: App
allocations add up to more than the budget.

spent.description:
Spent is all spend attributed to the team this period: its Apps
(including deleted ones) and its members' chat.

unattributed.description: Unattributed is spend no team could be resolved for.

connections.description:
Connections lists, per connection the App touches, whether a key can
be minted now and why not otherwise.

endpoint.description:
Endpoint is the URL Studio called: the upstream base plus /mcp, the
same path the Tyk Gateway will call.

truncated.description: Truncated is set when the server offered more tools than MaxTools.

verified.description: Verified is true when MDCB currently reports a data plane with this tag.

pin.description: Pin adds the new policy to ServerID's bundle straight away.

dashboard_validated.description:
DashboardValidated is always false today: Dashboard 5.14 persists dry
runs instead of validating them, so previews are Studio's own render
and checks and the Dashboard validates on create or push.

disabled_reason.description:
DisabledReason explains why Enabled is false when the operator did not
switch the feature off (e.g. the secrets encryption key is missing).

direct_create.description: full mode: approval creates the proxy

disabled_reason.description:
DisabledReason explains why Enabled is false when the operator did not
switch the feature off (e.g. the secrets encryption key is missing).

dropped_events.description:
DroppedEvents counts bus events this node could not persist even after
spilling to memory. Non-zero means at-least-once was violated.

signing_secret.description: SigningSecret is optional; a random one is generated when empty.
